source.purpose: Business review of the public Avenzo Studio website

global.request: Redefine H1/H2/H3 hierarchy and sizes for a more balanced website.
global.implementation: Use a consistent visual type scale while preserving valid semantic heading structure for SEO.
Remove CJK glyphs from public pages; use French labels such as 'Chinois' where needed.

global.request: Improve SEO and make footer reflect the website structure.
global.implementation: Add structured footer navigation, canonical/metadata, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and Organization JSON-LD.

global.request: Make it easy to add Google/Facebook tracking later.
global.implementation: Add an inactive tracking configuration/loader and documentation. No trackers load until IDs and consent are configured.

global.request: Remove visual sequence numbers such as 1,2,3,4.
global.implementation: Remove service, solution and method numbering from public UI.

global.request: Remove old-fashioned separator lines while keeping structure.
global.implementation: Use whitespace, rhythm and typography instead of visible rules/borders for primary section separation.

accueil.request: Move navigation (Accueil, Services, Solutions, Contact) to the right, close to 'Parler de votre projet'.
accueil.implementation: Right-align nav and CTA as one cluster.

accueil.request: Put 'Ensemble, on avance' where the large 'Avenzo Studio' currently is.
accueil.implementation: Use 'Ensemble, on avance' as hero H1.

accueil.request: Delete the large 'Avenzo Studio' and the France-China map from the hero.
accueil.implementation: Remove large brand heading and bridge map from hero; retain brand only in header/footer.

accueil.request: Make '4 expertises' the main focus in large bold type instead of 'Choisissez votre point d’entrée'.
accueil.implementation: Promote '4 expertises' to the primary section title and remove the old title.

accueil.request: Delete the brown 'Avenzo Studio' label above the company introduction.
Make 'Solutions' the main focus, larger, keep brown color; make 'Une combinaison...' slightly smaller.
accueil.implementation: Promote Solutions to large brown heading; demote descriptive line.

accueil.request: Make 'Pour des entreprises ambitieuses' the main heading and 'Des secteurs variés...' secondary.
Do not use a table/grid for the six sectors; list them simply with no lines.
accueil.implementation: Use a simple responsive text list without borders.

services.request: Keep the current two-column section structure but remove obvious lines.
services.implementation: Preserve left title/right details layout; remove separator borders.

services.request: Marketing & Digital Stratégie should be the main heading; 'Poser la stratégie...' should be secondary.
services.implementation: Use large service-name heading followed by smaller tagline.

services.request: Apply the same heading hierarchy to Digital & E-commerce and other service sections.
Keep detailed services presented on the right but delete the lines.
services.implementation: Keep two-column capability lists with whitespace only.
Remove numbers from jump navigation and section labels.

solutions.request: Delete the brown 'Solutions' label on the banner because it is redundant.
Delete the brown 'Avenzo Studio' label in the intro.
Make each solution category such as 'Présence digitale' the main heading; the descriptive phrase should be secondary.
solutions.implementation: Large brown category heading plus smaller descriptive subheading.

solutions.request: Remove lines between each solution section.
solutions.implementation: Separate sections by whitespace instead of rules.

contact.request: Delete the brown 'Contact' label on the banner.
Delete the brown 'Avenzo Studio' label above the contact intro.
Keep the form structure but restyle left contact information and remove the line above it.
contact.implementation: Balance columns, use compact contact info without top border.

non_goals: Do not add tracking IDs or external trackers without consent/configuration.
Do not change the approved Cormorant Garamond / Inter font pairing.

validation.note: Visual/SEO changes implemented from the 18-page business review. Tracking is prepared but intentionally disabled until IDs and consent are configured.
